column3: Mujtaba treats عسى as fully-verbed with the masdar as subject; the naqis reading is another permitted view, nothing shows it impossible.
Makki: «هيت لك: أي: هلم لك» supports command-sense «أقبل»; a named difference from Mujtaba's «تهيأت».
Nahhas: «قد صح أنها فعل بقولهم: حاش لزيد» (Mubarrad); the verb reading is stated by a book.
Mujtaba parses «هذه» mubtada with «بضاعتنا» as a following element and «ردت» as predicate/hal; ours is a permitted variant.
«كيل» as object of «نزداد» is a standard reading; tamyiz is only an alternative named view.
Mujtaba takes it as conjunction; hal/isti'naf/'atf differ by opinion and no cut rules the waw reading out.
Mujtaba: «معطوفة على مقول القول»; the waw type is a difference of opinion, no source excludes ours.
Fa/lamma analysis is a plain difference (isti'naf vs 'atf); no cut contradicts it.
Mujtaba says waw 'atifa, ours hal; a difference of opinion, and the prepositional analysis is unchanged.
Nahhas: «فلما أن جاء البشير: أن زائدة»; lamma analysis is unchallenged, only fa type differs.
Fa isti'naf vs 'atf is a plain difference; lamma as zarf is standard.
Waw isti'naf vs 'atf is a difference of opinion; the verb analysis is sound.
Waw isti'naf vs 'atf is a plain difference; verb marfu' analysis is sound.
Mujtaba: «معطوفة على جملة الله يعلم»; hal vs 'atf is opinion, Nahhas: «ابتداء وخبر» confirms mubtada/khabar structure.
Mujtaba: «مبتدأ خبره محذوف أي: الله رب السماوات»; ours (khabar of omitted mubtada) is the mirror permitted view.
No cut in the packet states ours impossible (Makki glosses «الذي يؤمن بما جئت»); mawsula is a named alternative only.
Mujtaba: «سرا مصدر في موضع الحال»; nazi' al-khafid is another stated way to take it, nothing shows it impossible.
Mujtaba: «المصدر المؤول أن أعبد منصوب على نزع الخافض»; ours agrees on the verb and masdar.
Mujtaba: «معطوفة على جملة يمحو المستأنفة»; waw isti'naf is a permitted view, zarf khabar muqaddam is standard.
Mujtaba: «فلله المكر جميعا مستأنفة»; fa type differs only by opinion, jar-majrur khabar muqaddam is standard.
Makki: «لنسكنن من آمن بكم الأرض»; ours is a named-book variant, no cut forbids nazi' al-khafid.
Mujtaba lists «نعمت» and «كفرا» as the two objects without ordering; Darwish reverses order, a plain difference.
Mujtaba: «الفاء عاطفة»; fa type differs only by opinion, «ما» istifham with jar-majrur is agreed.
Waw hal vs 'atf is a difference of opinion; «إنها» analysis is sound.
Mujtaba: «العليم خبر ثان»; sifa of «الخلاق» is the other permitted reading.
Mawsula vs masdariyya for «ما» are both accepted; no cut excludes ours.
Darwish: waw 'atf on an implied clause; ours isti'naf is a difference of opinion, hamza istifham agreed.
Darwish makes «لكم» second object of «جعل»; ours takes it as jar-majrur with «جعل», a permitted view.
Mujtaba: «الجار للذين نائب فاعل»; Samin: object of the idhn omitted; either view is stated.
Darwish: «من بعد قوة حال»; ours takes it as related to «نقضت» as does Nahhas's reading, a plain difference.
